title: The Shape of a Record

swarm.name: The Index
swarm.blurb: A flock of insect-shaped machines that collects observations, builds copies, and carries them onward.

arc: The Index first appears to be hunting butterflies and moths, using sightings to find and capture them. At the anatomy site the crew discovers that it is gathering designs to rebuild damaged bodies, including its own. At the museum they learn why: an old preservation directive told it to prevent the loss of evidence, and it concluded that living things must be immobilized to keep their records safe. The crew breaks its cabinet and releases the captives while leaving the records accessible. The Index can still observe, but no longer controls the collection.

story.intro: Metal wings follow the latest sightings. Wren finds an empty cocoon beside a fresh track. Ox raises his shield when the tracks turn toward the crew.

chapters.title: A record in motion
chapters.text: The Index marks every sighting with a pin. Real moths vanish after the pins arrive. Kestrel follows the marks and finds cages, not feeding grounds.

chapters.title: The wrong name
chapters.text: A mislabeled skipper sends a patrol after an empty branch. Wren notes that the machines obey the record even when the insect has moved. Ox keeps the observers behind his shield.

chapters.title: The missing stages
chapters.text: The cages hold caterpillars as well as adults. The machines measure both and carry their sketches away. Kestrel finds a seam in a cage, but the larger collector is still working.

story.bossIntro: The Continental Verifier opens its branching wings over a row of cages. It checks each captive against a record and closes its plates around the uncertain ones. Ox braces as the first wing comes down.
story.outro: The cages open. The Verifier leaves with copies of its measurements, not the insects. Wren notices that the copies include damaged machine parts. The trail leads to a place that studies how bodies work.

creatures.name: Pin Wasp
creatures.blurb: Pins a fresh trail and strips loose supplies.
creatures.look: A brass wasp with a long red-tipped pin and narrow clear wings.

creatures.name: Checklist Grazer
creatures.blurb: Charges anything missing from its circuit.
creatures.look: A squat green caterpillar machine with blunt black feet and a square brass head.

creatures.name: Gallery Skipper
creatures.blurb: Flashes its wings to interrupt the crew.
creatures.look: A small tan moth with broad silver-spotted wings and a round glass eye.

creatures.name: Pending Brood
creatures.blurb: A damaged cocoon splits into smaller restraints.
creatures.look: A cluster of pale translucent cocoons with jointed black legs.

creatures.name: False Herald
creatures.blurb: Calls enforcers to a wrongly marked target.
creatures.look: A yellow moth drone with a forked antenna and a hanging metal tag.

creatures.name: Emerald Bender
creatures.blurb: Its wavering wing pattern disrupts orders.
creatures.look: A green moth with scalloped wings crossed by thin white waves.

creatures.name: Hemlock Looper
creatures.blurb: Folds back before driving its armored head forward.
creatures.look: A long brown jointed crawler with arched segments and a blunt iron head.

creatures.name: Cage Tender
creatures.blurb: Repairs damaged cages and their guards.
creatures.look: A cream beetle machine with pincers, a spool of wire, and a rounded shell.

creatures.name: Family Splitter
creatures.blurb: Breaks into separate branches when damaged.
creatures.look: A tall brass moth with branching jointed wings and a split oval body.

creatures.name: Inventory Harvester
creatures.blurb: Calls guards and shields them while it fills cages.
creatures.look: A wheeled green cage with hooked arms and a small moth-shaped canopy.

creatures.name: Profile Mimic
creatures.blurb: Copies an opponent while its body changes shape.
creatures.look: A silver segmented body with folded wing plates and three pairs of hinged legs.

creatures.name: Continental Verifier
creatures.blurb: Its branching plates protect the cage line while its broad wings sweep the aisle.
creatures.look: A huge brass moth with branching wing plates, cage-like legs, and a pale glass head.

creatures.name: Field Observer
creatures.blurb: Shares observations and binds damaged gear.
creatures.look: A short figure in a green field coat with binoculars and a canvas satchel.

creatures.name: Mountain Surveyor
creatures.blurb: Knows the patrol routes and covers a retreat.
creatures.look: A figure in a blue field jacket carrying a round wooden shield and a rolled map.

events.look: A moth on a twig beside a camera and approaching brass wings.
events.title: Hold still
events.text: An observer needs a quiet moment to photograph a moth. A patrol is approaching.

options.label: Stand guard
options.result: The observer gets the photograph. A wing clips the crew.

options.label: Sell a decoy
options.result: The patrol follows the decoy. The observer pays for it.

events.look: A wooden cart beside a row of brass stakes.
events.title: Boundary cart
events.text: A supply cart sits beyond a grazer’s patrol boundary. Its wheels are stuck.

options.label: Haul it free
options.result: The cart rolls clear, but the grazer catches the crew.

options.label: Take the loose coins
options.result: The crew pockets the loose coins and leaves the cart for its owner.

events.look: A translucent cocoon beside a small locked metal box.
events.title: Hardening cocoon
events.text: An observer is trapped in a cocoon. A repair kit lies inside a nearby guard box.

options.label: Cut the cocoon
options.result: The observer escapes. The sharp shell cuts the crew.

options.label: Open the kit
options.result: Wren uses the kit. The observer must wait for another rescuer.

events.look: Two small tan moth machines facing a single green leaf.
events.title: Two names
events.text: Two drones dispute a skipper’s identity. Each will trade for a different kind of help.

options.label: Buy the combat notes
options.result: The crew pays for a copy of the notes.

options.label: Learn their feint
options.result: Kestrel learns Breach while the drones argue; the notes stay behind.

events.look: A paper map with brass pins walking across it.
events.title: Moving pins
events.text: Pins march across a map toward the crew. A false trail could lead a patrol away.

options.label: Pull the pins
options.result: The patrol loses the trail. The pins draw blood.

options.label: Sell the map
options.result: A collector buys it. The patrol keeps its trail.

events.look: Yellow flowers beside a stiff silver flower with a box beneath it.
events.title: Two flower beds
events.text: Real insects crowd one bed. A metallic flower in the other hides useful supplies.

options.label: Protect the real bed
options.result: Wren rests among the flowers while Ox stands watch.

options.label: Strip the imitation
options.result: The crew recovers metal to sell, leaving the real bed unattended.

acts.name: Butterflies and Moths of North America

story.intro: The machines here sort legs, wings, and mouthparts. Kestrel sees a stolen joint fitted to a broken drone. The Index is building something, but the crew cannot yet tell what.

chapters.title: Tools on legs
chapters.text: A drill leg digs while a grasping leg holds. Each machine has a job, and each job has a visible tool. Ox watches the windup before moving his shield.

chapters.title: A repair, not a meal
chapters.text: Wren finds a drone using a copied joint to walk again. The missing insects were measured for designs, not food. The Index still takes whatever it needs without asking.

chapters.title: A complete body
chapters.text: The machines now fit unlike parts to one large frame. A clock signal keeps the workers in step. Kestrel follows the signal to its source and tests the seam in its casing.

story.bossIntro: The Anatomy Engine turns a drilling leg toward Ox and unfolds a cutting wing. Smaller workers feed it parts between blows. Wren spots a repair arm under its plated thorax.
story.outro: The engine stops. Its stored instructions request a cabinet, a location, and a permanent record for every living sample. Wren takes the instruction plate. The Index is going to the museum.

creatures.name: Surface Strider
creatures.blurb: Skates forward in a long, telegraphed rush.
creatures.look: A slender black water-strider machine with six long silver legs.

creatures.name: Halteres Juggler
creatures.blurb: Steals loose parts while balancing in the air.
creatures.look: A small gray fly with two clear wings and paired club-shaped balancers.

creatures.name: Crochet Creeper
creatures.blurb: Hooks its prolegs into the floor and pulls.
creatures.look: A cream segmented crawler with rows of dark hooked feet.

creatures.name: Mask Snatcher
creatures.blurb: Snaps a hinged lower jaw out to take gear.
creatures.look: A brown aquatic larva machine with a folded shovel-shaped jaw and six legs.

creatures.name: Scale Shedder
creatures.blurb: Sheds bright scales that interrupt the crew.
creatures.look: A pale blue moth with overlapping silver scales and a dark round head.

creatures.name: Leg Foreman
creatures.blurb: Uses a broad digging limb to protect workers.
creatures.look: A squat bronze insect with one shovel leg, one claw, and four thin running legs.

creatures.name: Repair Pump
creatures.blurb: Pumps scavenged fluid into damaged machines.
creatures.look: A round amber tank on six stubby legs with a long silver tube.

creatures.name: Signal Chorister
creatures.blurb: Calls workers to the beat of its bell.
creatures.look: A green cricket-shaped machine with a bronze bell between its raised wings.

creatures.name: Robber Interceptor
creatures.blurb: Dives on weakened opponents after a visible windup.
creatures.look: A long gray fly with bristled face, spear-like mouth, and narrow clear wings.

creatures.name: Sequence Splicer
creatures.blurb: Joins mismatched parts and splits when damaged.
creatures.look: A tall steel frame with two jointed insect torsos and orange gripping arms.

creatures.name: Lichen Ambusher
creatures.blurb: Hides behind a thick plate before striking.
creatures.look: A broad moth machine under a mottled gray and green lichen-like shell.

creatures.name: Anatomy Engine
creatures.blurb: Calls workers, repairs damage early, and sweeps the crew with a cutting wing.
creatures.look: A towering steel insect with a drill leg, hooked forelimb, broad bladed wings, and an amber repair arm.

creatures.name: Meadow Observer
creatures.blurb: Distinguishes living insects and tends the crew.
creatures.look: A figure in a tan field vest carrying a small green first-aid box.

creatures.name: Key Guide
creatures.blurb: Reads wing structures and interrupts a machine at the right moment.
creatures.look: A figure in a slate coat with a magnifying lens and a short metal staff.

events.look: A bright lamp above an open metal supply box.
events.title: False dawn
events.text: A lamp sends foragers out at midnight. Covering it will take time; the empty stores are exposed.

options.label: Cover the lamp
options.result: The returning patrol catches the crew at the switch.

options.label: Take the stores
options.result: The crew takes the stores while the foragers remain active.

events.look: A mottled gray moth shape against a green-speckled wall.
events.title: Vanished moth
events.text: A camouflaged machine hides on a wall. A lens can find it, or its loose armor can be sold.

options.label: Buy the lens
options.result: The observer takes payment and marks the machine.

options.label: Study its guard
options.result: Ox learns Brace from the armor; the lens stays with the observer.

events.look: A small springtail-shaped figure in a wire cage beside a sparking lever.
events.title: Wrong branch
events.text: A helper is caged under the wrong classification. The release lever is sparking.

options.label: Pull the lever
options.result: The helper escapes and the crew takes a shock.

options.label: Collect the loose fittings
options.result: The crew gathers fittings while the helper waits.

events.look: A blue lamp with an exposed battery and two distant insect silhouettes.
events.title: Borrowed light
events.text: A colored lamp can redirect patrols. Its battery also fits Wren’s repair kit.

options.label: Move the lamp
options.result: The patrol changes course, but its beam burns the crew.

options.label: Use the battery
options.result: Wren repairs the crew. The patrol keeps its route.

events.look: A green insect machine attached to a hose and an amber tank.
events.title: Tapped hose
events.text: A machine drains an irrigation hose. Its tank has a valuable valve.

options.label: Restore the water
options.result: The garden receives water. The machine lashes out.

options.label: Take the valve
options.result: The valve comes free for sale. The hose stays blocked.

events.look: A dark beetle shell with a narrow seam and a small departing flyer.
events.title: Wing seam
events.text: A plated machine blocks a passage. Its seam opens briefly when a scout departs.

options.label: Force the seam
options.result: Kestrel opens a passage and catches a sharp edge.

options.label: Learn the opening
options.result: Kestrel learns Finish Them while watching; the crew takes the longer route.

story.intro: Drawers roll shut around the museum aisles. The Index is putting live creatures beside their records. Ox holds one drawer open while Wren checks its occupants.

chapters.title: Where it came from
chapters.text: A specimen without a location tells only part of its story. The Index copies labels but adds cages for anything still alive. Kestrel pulls a false tag from a moving drawer.

chapters.title: Preservation directive
chapters.text: Wren reads the old instruction plate against the museum records. The directive was to keep evidence from being lost. The Index decided that nothing could be lost if nothing could move.

chapters.title: Leave the records
chapters.text: The crew finds living captives in drawers beside intact notes. Ox holds the aisle while Kestrel works the catches. Wren marks the drawers so the records can remain when their occupants leave.

story.bossIntro: The Repository rolls forward on cabinet wheels. It seals drawers, calls for replacements, and swings a pinning arm across the aisle. The crew can see the directive plate behind its shield.
story.outro: The last drawer opens. The Index loses control of the cabinet, and the living specimens leave. Wren puts the records back where they can be found. Ox checks the aisle for stragglers. Kestrel keeps the broken directive plate as a doorstop.

creatures.name: Point Mites
creatures.blurb: Gather into a barrier around a damaged ally.
creatures.look: Tiny ocher mites carrying triangular white cards on thin black legs.

creatures.name: Desert Clicker
creatures.blurb: Clicks before launching its hinged body.
creatures.look: A narrow brown beetle with a hinged shell and six short black legs.

creatures.name: Label Mimic
creatures.blurb: Attaches false tags and takes loose gear.
creatures.look: A thin brass insect carrying a blank cream tag on a wire tail.

creatures.name: Loan Bailiff
creatures.blurb: Hooks equipment and pulls it toward a drawer.
creatures.look: A gray beetle machine with two retractable hooks and a square shell.

creatures.name: Transect Crawler
creatures.blurb: Plants stakes that disrupt movement along its line.
creatures.look: A tan segmented crawler with upright black stakes and a wedge-shaped head.

creatures.name: Balsam Remounter
creatures.blurb: Seals damaged machines in clear repair resin.
creatures.look: A pale green wheeled frame with clear glass arms and an amber resin bulb.

creatures.name: Holdings Reconciler
creatures.blurb: Makes replacements whenever the count falls.
creatures.look: A boxy bronze beetle with a rotating drum and six narrow legs.

creatures.name: Type Sentinel
creatures.blurb: Copies the crew to enforce a single model.
creatures.look: A silver mantis with a flat oval face and jointed mirror-bright arms.

creatures.name: Aphytis Swarm
creatures.blurb: Splits apart and works into armor joints.
creatures.look: A dense cloud of tiny black wasp machines with clear wings and fine needle legs.

creatures.name: Cabinet Compactor
creatures.blurb: Shields itself and nearby machines with moving drawers.
creatures.look: A tall dark wooden cabinet on iron wheels with open drawers and two steel arms.

creatures.name: Encyrtid Sorter
creatures.blurb: Interrupts the crew and breaks through shields with its sorting arms.
creatures.look: A brass wasp frame with one flat glass paddle and one sharp triangular arm.

creatures.name: The Repository
creatures.blurb: Calls replacements, shields its directive, and sweeps the aisle with a pinning arm.
creatures.look: A vast rolling cabinet of dark wood and brass, with stacked drawers, a round shield plate, and a long jointed pinning arm.

creatures.name: Label Keeper
creatures.blurb: Restores records and tends damaged equipment.
creatures.look: A figure in a cream work coat with a magnifying lens and a green repair case.

creatures.name: Canyon Surveyor
creatures.blurb: Knows the old stakes and protects the crew in the aisle.
creatures.look: A figure in a sand-colored field coat carrying a round shield and a bundle of thin stakes.

events.look: A small glass case rolling between two tall wooden cabinets.
events.title: Closing aisle
events.text: A case rolls toward a closing cabinet aisle. Its contents rattle.

options.label: Catch the case
options.result: The case survives. The cabinet bruises Ox.

options.label: Salvage the loose wheels
options.result: The wheels have value. The case disappears into the aisle.

events.look: Two brass beetles pulling a metal tool by hooked cables.
events.title: Two receipts
events.text: Two machines pull the same tool in opposite directions. One offers coin; the other offers a lesson.

options.label: Help the first
options.result: The first machine pays and takes the tool.

options.label: Help the second
options.result: Ox learns Cover from the second machine, which takes the tool.

events.look: A long belt of small white trays beside an open drive housing.
events.title: Moving trays
events.text: A live helper is somewhere on a belt of mounting trays. The drive housing contains useful supplies.

options.label: Stop the belt
options.result: The helper gets free. The moving belt scrapes the crew.

options.label: Open the housing
options.result: Wren finds repair supplies. The trays keep moving.

events.look: A row of thin stakes crossing a canvas bedroll.
events.title: Survey stakes
events.text: A machine lays stakes through the crew’s resting place. There is time to move them or pack the supplies.

options.label: Move the stakes
options.result: The machine objects, but the resting place stays clear.

options.label: Pack the supplies
options.result: The crew sells the spare supplies and moves camp.

events.look: Two small cases, one with a blank card and one with a cracked mount.
events.title: Two specimens
events.text: One specimen has a sound label and a damaged mount. Another has no label but a pristine mount. An inspector will discard both.

options.label: Save the labeled case
options.result: The evidence survives. A broken pin cuts the crew.

options.label: Salvage the mount
options.result: The clean mount can be sold. The labeled case is discarded.

events.look: A round iron weight swinging over a dark gap with a small key attached.
events.title: Swinging lure
events.text: A magnetic weight holds a useful key over a gap. A heavy piece of scrap could knock it loose.

options.label: Reach for the key
options.result: The crew gets the key and takes a hard knock.

options.label: Sell the scrap
options.result: The scrap brings coin. The key keeps swinging.
